claims.claim: Rybakina war die erste kasachische Sportlerin, die ein Einzel-Finale bei einem Grand-Slam-Turnier erreichte
claims.note: Article says Rybakina was the first Kazakh athlete to reach a singles major final (Wimbledon 2022).

claims.claim: Ihre Saisonbilanz 2025 lautete 58 Siege und 19 Niederlagen, 14 davon nach den US Open
claims.note: Article says her season record was 58-19, with 14 of those wins coming after the US Open.

valueNote: The two added sentences give the Kazakh first and the 2025 season record, which the page did not state before.
summary: Both sentences added in this revision are confirmed by their cited sources. The rest of the page was approved earlier and was not re-checked in this pass.
